email.subject: Pearl Pros Dentistry: mobile visitors can't call you
email.body:
Jack,

I checked Pearl Pros' site. On mobile, there's no click-to-call button and the layout isn't optimized for phones, so patients searching "dentist near me" on their phone can't tap to call you — that's likely your biggest source of lost new-patient calls. The site also has no reviews shown and doesn't list your hours, which makes new visitors hesitate before booking.

I fix these for a flat fee, no ongoing contract. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's costing you calls? No pressure either way.

Alex
Northlight Web
